# TPC-Havoc Q6_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(l1.l_extendedprice * l1.l_discount) AS revenue
FROM lineitem AS l1, (
  SELECT
    1 AS dummy
) AS dummy_table
WHERE
  l1.l_shipdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND l1.l_shipdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
  AND l1.l_discount BETWEEN 0.06 - 0.01 AND 0.06 + 0.01
  AND l1.l_quantity < 24
```
